 Important Agent Settings

                    

                    

                        
 Realtime Models (Audio-to-Audio)


                        

                             Realtime Pipeline:
                            
Realtime mode uses a single audio-to-audio stream instead of separate STT + LLM + TTS components. Select "Realtime" in Pipeline Mode when creating an agent.

                            
    
                                
  • Google Gemini Live: Gemini 3.1 Flash Live (Preview) and 2.5 Flash Native Audio — <200ms latency, supports language selection, proactivity, affective dialog, thinking budget
    • 
                                
  • Google Vertex AI: Gemini Live 2.5 Flash Native Audio (GA) via enterprise Vertex AI (requires Service Account)
    • 
                                
  • OpenAI: GPT Realtime 2 (GPT-5-class), GPT Realtime 1.5, GPT Realtime Mini, GPT Realtime — ~300ms, playback speed, turn detection, noise reduction
    • 
                                
  • xAI (Grok): Grok Voice Think Fast 1.0 and Grok Voice Fast 1.0 — ~300ms, playback speed, turn detection, noise reduction
    • 
                                
  • AWS Nova Sonic: Amazon Nova 2 Sonic — ~300ms, top_p, max_tokens, turn detection sensitivity
    • 
                                
  • Azure OpenAI: GPT Realtime (GA), GPT Realtime Mini (GA), GPT-4o Realtime Preview, GPT-4o Mini Realtime Preview — uses Azure deployment
    • 
                            

                            
 Advanced options (language, proactivity, etc.) are shown or hidden automatically based on the selected provider's capabilities.

                        


                        
 STT Provider Notes


                        

                             Deepgram Flux Models:
                            
    
                                
  • Do NOT use "Eager EOT Threshold" setting
    • 
                                
  • Flux handles endpointing internally
    • 
                                
  • Only model and keywords/keyterms are supported
    • 
                            

                        


                        

                             OpenAI STT Models:
                            
    
                                
  • Smart formatting & filler removal are automatic
    • 
                                
  • Use VAD settings to control responsiveness (not model settings)
    • 
                                
  • whisper-1: Stable streaming STT — supports custom vocabulary via prompt
    • 
                                
  • gpt-4o-transcribe: Best quality, newer model
    • 
                            

                        


                        

                             Groq Whisper Models (separate provider):
                            
    
                                
  • whisper-large-v3-turbo: 8x faster, best for real-time
    • 
                                
  • whisper-large-v3: Highest accuracy, slight delay
    • 
                                
  • distil-whisper-large-v3-en: English-only, smallest/fastest
    • 
                            

                        


                        

                             General Tips:
                            
    
                                
  • VAD Threshold: 0.35 (balanced sensitivity for voice detection)
    • 
                                
  • Min Silence: 150ms for quick turn-taking without false triggers
    • 
                                
  • Response Delay: 0s for instant agent responses
    • 
                                
  • Turn Detector is enabled by default - provides 39% fewer false interruptions
    • 
                            

                        


                        

                             Turn Detector:
                            
    
                                
  • Multilingual Support: Works with 14 languages out of the box
    • 
                                
  • Default Threshold: 0.008 (balanced for most use cases)
    • 
                                
  • EOT Timeout: 2500ms (optimized for natural conversation)
    • 
                                
  • Range: 0.005-0.015 recommended | Lower = more sensitive
    • 
                                
  • Result: 39% fewer false interruptions vs VAD-only mode
    • 
                            

                        


                        

                             Fail2ban Security:
                            
    
                                
  • Protection: Blocks brute-force login attacks, vulnerability scanners, and rate limit abuse
    • 
                                
  • Jails: auth (30min), scanner (24hr), ratelimit (10min), recidive (7 days)
    • 
                                
  • Auto-Whitelist: IPs added to SIP trunks are automatically whitelisted
    • 
                                
  • Management: View/ban/unban IPs in Settings → Security tab
    • 
                            

                        


                        

                             Deepgram Flux Turn Detection:
                            
    
                                
  • Availability: Only available when using Deepgram Flux STT models
    • 
                                
  • EOT Threshold (default 0.7): Confidence level (0.0–1.0) that the user has finished speaking. Higher values wait longer for certainty, lower values trigger faster responses.
    • 
                                
  • EOT Timeout (default 2500ms): Maximum time to wait after speech stops before forcing an end-of-turn, even if the confidence threshold hasn't been reached.
    • 
                                
  • Eager EOT Threshold (optional): Enables early end-of-turn detection at a lower confidence level for faster responses. Disabled by default — set a value below the main EOT Threshold to enable.
    • 
                                
  • Note: When Flux turn detection is enabled, it replaces the MultilingualModel Turn Detector. Silero VAD still runs independently for voice activity detection.
    • 
                            

                        

                    

                

            

        


        
        

            
            

                

                    

                        
 Turn Detector Guide

                    

                    

                        
Optimal Settings:

                        
    
                            
  • Default (0.008): Balanced, works for most cases
    • 
                            
  • Lower (0.005): Fast-paced conversations, quick responses
    • 
                            
  • Higher (0.012): Thoughtful pauses, avoid interruptions
    • 
                            
  • English optimized: 0.011
    • 
                        

                        
When to Disable:

                        
    
                            
  • Simple Q&A bots (no natural conversation)
    • 
                            
  • High-latency networks
    • 
                            
  • Testing/debugging VAD issues
    • 
                        

                    

                

            


            
            

                

                    

                        
 STT Model Selection

                    

                    

                        
Deepgram:

                        
    
                            
  • Nova 3: Best accuracy, real-time optimized
    • 
                            
  • Flux: Low-latency, handles endpointing internally
    • 
                        

                        
OpenAI:

                        
    
                            
  • GPT-4o Transcribe: Best quality, newer model
    • 
                            
  • Whisper-1: Stable streaming STT, supports custom vocabulary via prompt
    • 
                        

                        
Groq Whisper:

                        
    
                            
  • Large v3 Turbo: 8x faster, best for real-time calls
    • 
                            
  • Large v3: Highest accuracy, slight delay
    • 
                            
  • Distil v3 (English): Smallest, fastest
    • 
                        

                        
Tip: Use VAD settings to control responsiveness, not STT model alone.

                    

                

            


            
            

                

                    

                        
 Troubleshooting

                    

                    

                        
Agent Not Answering:

                        
    
                            
  • Check System Logs for errors
    • 
                            
  • Verify STT/TTS provider API keys
    • 
                            
  • Ensure Turn Detector plugin installed if enabled
    • 
                        

                        
Frequent Interruptions:

                        
    
                            
  • Increase Turn Detector threshold (0.010-0.015)
    • 
                            
  • Adjust VAD min_speech_duration
    • 
                            
  • Check network quality (RTT <150ms ideal)
    • 
                        

                        
Slow Responses:

                        
    
                            
  • Lower VAD threshold (0.4-0.5)
    • 
                            
  • Use faster STT model (Flux, V3 Turbo)
    • 
                            
  • Reduce agent_response_delay
    • 
                        

                    

                

            

        


        
        

            

                

                    

                        
 Agent Handoff: Transfer & Transition

                    

                    

                        
Two ways to hand off a call between agents, each designed for a different experience.

                        

                            

                                

                                    

                                        
 Transfer (Department Change)

                                    

                                    

                                        
Like a Receptionist handing you over to Tech Support.

                                        
    
                                            
  • What happens: The receptionist stops talking, tells you "Please hold," and connects you to a completely different person.
    • 
                                            
  • The experience: You hear a switch. You know you are talking to someone new.
    • 
                                            
  • Memory: The new person needs a quick summary ("He has a broken printer") but doesn't need every small detail of the chit-chat you had with the receptionist.
    • 
                                            
  • Best for: Moving a caller from Sales to Support, or Reception to Billing.
    • 
                                        

                                    

                                

                            

                            

                                

                                    

                                        
 Transition (Multi-Prompt)

                                    

                                    

                                        
Like a Salesperson opening a new page in their notebook.

                                        
    
                                            
  • What happens: The salesperson stops asking about your budget (Qualification phase) and immediately starts asking about dates (Scheduling phase).
    • 
                                            
  • The experience: It feels like the same person is just moving the conversation forward. There is no "Please hold." It is silent and seamless.
    • 
                                            
  • Memory: The "new" version of the agent remembers everything. It knows your name, your budget, and your dog's name because it needs to keep the conversation flowing naturally.
    • 
                                            
  • Best for: Complex scripts where you want to Qualify → Sell → Close without the user knowing they are being passed between different "brains."
    • 
                                        

                                    

                                

                            

                        

                        

                            

                                
                                    

                                        Feature
                                        Transfer (Department)
                                        Transition (Multi-Prompt)
                                    

                                
                                
                                    

                                        Sound
                                        "Please hold while I transfer you..."
                                        Silent (No interruption)
                                    

                                    

                                        Feeling
                                        Talking to a new person
                                        Talking to the same person
                                    

                                    

                                        Memory
                                        Starts fresh or with a summary
                                        Remembers everything perfectly
                                    

                                    

                                        Goal
                                        Change the department
                                        Change the topic
                                    

                                
                            

                        

                    

                

            

        


        
        

            

                

                    

                        
 Call Detail Metrics

                    

                    

                        
The Call Detail page displays latency metrics for each completed call. These help you understand how quickly your agent responds and where time is spent in the pipeline.


                        

                             TTFB (Time-To-First-Byte):
                            

                                Total time from the user finishing speech to the agent starting to speak. This is the single most important responsiveness metric.
                                
Color coding: Green ≤500ms (excellent)   >500ms (acceptable)   >1000ms (needs optimization)
                            

                        


                        

                             Latency Breakdown (Stacked Bar):
                            

                                Shows the three pipeline components that make up the total TTFB, averaged across all turns in the call:
                            

                            
    
                                
  • STT (Speech-to-Text): Time for the STT provider to transcribe the user's speech into text.
    • 
                                
  • LLM (Time-to-First-Token): Time for the LLM to begin generating a response after receiving the transcript.
    • 
                                
  • TTS (Text-to-Speech): Time for the TTS provider to produce the first audio chunk from the LLM output.
    • 
                            

                        


                        

                             Percentiles (P50 / P90 / P99):
                            

                                Percentiles of total TTFB measured across all conversational turns in the call:
                            

                            
    
                                
  • P50 (Median): Half of all turns were faster than this value. Represents the typical experience.
    • 
                                
  • P90: 90% of turns were faster — only 10% were slower. Shows near-worst-case performance.
    • 
                                
  • P99: 99% of turns were faster — captures the worst-case outlier turns (e.g., cold starts, retries).
    • 
                            

                        

                    

                

            

        


        
        

            

                

                    

                        
 Agent Tester: Tool Support

                    

                    

                        
The Agent Tester supports tool calling in both Voice mode and Text mode. This allows you to test tools like sending emails, SMS messages, and webhook integrations without making actual phone calls.


                        

                            

                                
 Tools That Work in Text Mode

                                

                                    
                                        

                                            Tool
                                            Notes
                                        

                                    
                                    
                                        

                                            send_email
                                            Fully functional - only requires SMTP/SES config
                                        

                                        

                                            send_sms
                                            Fully functional - provider dropdown (Tronic Cloud / Twilio / Telnyx via Settings → Integrations keys, or Custom via your own n8n workflow)
                                        

                                        

                                            Webhook Tools
                                            Fully functional - only requires HTTP endpoint
                                        

                                        

                                            end_call
                                            Returns "not in a call" message (graceful handling)
                                        

                                    
                                

                            

                            

                                
 Tools That Require Voice Mode

                                

                                    
                                        

                                            Tool
                                            Reason
                                        

                                    
                                    
                                        

                                            blind_transfer
                                            Requires active SIP participant
                                        

                                        

                                            attended_transfer
                                            Requires active SIP participant
                                        

                                        

                                            collect_dtmf
                                            Collect keypad digits (DTMF) or spoken digits from callers. Standard pipeline only.
                                        

                                    
                                

                                

                                     Tools requiring voice/SIP context will return a helpful error message when triggered in text mode.

 Widget Abuse Protection

                    

                    

                        

                            Limits how many widget sessions one visitor (by IP) can start per day across ALL chat agents on this install. Each chat agent also has its own daily cap in the agent editor.
                        

                        

                            
                            
                            Default 20. Email alerts configured under Reports (trigger: Widget Abuse — Daily Limit Reached).

                                    including the login page. Everyone else sees a plain "access restricted" message.
                                

                            

                            

                                
                            

                        


                        

                            
                                
 Read this before turning it on

                                
                                    Click for more
                                    
                                
                            
                            

                                

                                    

                                        If your internet address changes (many home and small-office connections
                                        change theirs periodically), you will be locked out of the dashboard.
                                        The same applies after restoring a backup onto a different server.
                                    

                                    

                                        To get back in, connect to the server over SSH and run:
                                    

                                    
cd /path/to/livekit-dashboard
poetry run python -m app.scripts.ip_lock --disable

                                    

                                        Access is restored within about 10 seconds — no restart needed, and your
                                        address list is kept. If you use a hostname below, also add at least one
                                        plain IP address, so a DNS problem cannot shut you out.

                        Settings
                    

                    
                

                

                    
                    
Configure dashboard settings, API keys, integrations, user permissions, security, and system resources across 8 tabs.


                    
                    

                        

                             General Tab
                        

                        
                        
View LiveKit server connection status, server URL, and license information. Configure timezone for call history timestamps.

                        
                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             White-Label sub-tab — Theme & Appearance
                        

                        
                        
Recolour the dashboard for every login (login page included): a colour preset or custom accent colour, a background tone (Charcoal/Slate/Navy/Graphite/Midnight), a text colour, and a system font. Picks preview live; Save Theme applies them, Reset to Defaults reverts everything. The main administrator also gets an Advanced: Custom CSS box (validated: no HTML, no backslash escapes, no @import, only /static/ URLs, 50,000 chars) with Preview CSS. Recovery from a rule that hides the page: append ?safe_theme=1 to any dashboard URL, then Reset.

                        
                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Licensing Tab (Community Edition only)
                        

                        
                        
A yellow-highlighted tab shown only while the install runs the free Community Edition tier: explains the 2-voice-agent / 2-chatbot limit and how to upgrade to a full (unlimited) licence. The sidebar's Community Edition badge links here.

                                        Description

                                        OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI (Grok) API keys for agent AI
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        STT Providers
                                        Deepgram, OpenAI, Google, ElevenLabs Scribe, AssemblyAI, Speechmatics, Sarvam (Indic) keys for speech recognition

                                        ElevenLabs, Cartesia, OpenAI, Google, AWS Polly, MiniMax, Speechmatics (Preview), Sarvam (Indic) keys for voice synthesis

Shows success with latency (e.g., 'OK 342ms') or specific error message on failure.

                             API Key Test Buttons
                        

                        
                        
Each configured API key has a Test button that makes a lightweight API call to verify the key is valid and working. This helps diagnose issues like expired keys, insufficient credits, or invalid credentials without waiting for a call to fail.

                                        STT/TTS Tests

                             REST API sub-tab
                        

                        
                        
Generates Bearer-authenticated keys (sk-rest-...) that let external tools trigger outbound calls via POST /external/v1/calls and look up status via GET /external/v1/calls/{id}. The Chatbot API card adds two separate switches (off by default): the Chatbot sessions API (POST /external/v1/chats, POST /chats/{id}/messages for a reply in the same response, GET /chats/{id} for the transcript, POST /chats/{id}/end) and the Outbound SMS API (POST /external/v1/sms from a chatbot's configured number), each with a per-key daily limit. API chats appear in Chat History as web chats with their cost; idle ones close after the chatbot's inactivity timeout. Not available on hosted multi-tenant deployments yet. Designed for workflow nodes (n8n, Zapier, Make) and custom scripts. Disabled by default — flip the toggle to enable. Max 20 keys. New keys default to 10 requests/min (tighter than MCP's 60 because calls cost real money).

                        
                        
                        

                            

                                
                                    

                                        Field
                                        Description
                                    

                                
                                
                                    
                                    

                                        Permission: Can Make Calls
                                        Key can initiate outbound calls via POST and check status via GET
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Permission: Read Only
                                        Key can only look up call status via GET — cannot initiate calls
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Allowed IPs
                                        IP allowlist (CIDR supported). Use 'Any IP' checkbox for unrestricted, but only for trusted environments
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Rate Limit
                                        Requests per minute. Set 0 for unlimited (not recommended — a leaked key could burn SIP minutes unchecked)
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Dynamic Variables
                                        Any JSON keys you pass in 'dynamic_variables' are substituted into {{KeyName}} placeholders in the agent's prompt/greeting/voicemail at call time — so the agent can address the caller by name, mention their company, etc.
                                    

                                    
                                
                            

                        

                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             MCP Server sub-tab
                        

                        
                        
Generates Bearer-authenticated keys (sk-mcp-...) for Claude Code, Cursor, and other Model Context Protocol clients to manage the dashboard programmatically. Separate from the REST API — different key prefix, different namespace. Keys cannot cross over (MCP keys can't auth REST endpoints and vice versa). Disabled by default. Max 20 keys, 60 requests/min per key default.

                        
                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             User Management Tab
                        

                        
                        
Create sub-users with specific page access and action permissions. Use the Quick Set templates (Read Only, Power User, Full Access, Customer Access, Reseller) or tick boxes by hand. Permissions are enforced at both the route level and UI level - buttons and pages are hidden if the user lacks permission. Sub-users only see the agents, chatbots, knowledge bases and phone numbers assigned to them on the Agents tab; nothing assigned means they see none.

                                        Every action on every page except Settings. Can manage agents, rooms, and telephony.
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Full Access
                                        Every action on every page, including Settings. Sub-user management, updates, restarts, the IP Lock and fail2ban actions stay main-admin only.

View-only elsewhere; no telephony configuration.
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Custom
                                        Tick individual boxes. Any action ticked on a page also ticks View for that page (except Settings).

                             Security Tab (Fail2ban)
                        

                        
                        
IP protection using fail2ban integration. Automatically bans IPs after repeated failed login attempts, invalid email probes, vulnerability scans, or rate limit violations. Main admin only.

                        
                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Security - IP Protection Status
                        

                        
                        
                        

                            

                                
                                    

                                        Field
                                        Description
                                    

                                
                                
                                    
                                    

                                        Protection Status
                                        Shows if fail2ban is installed, running, and protecting the dashboard
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Banned IPs
                                        Count of currently banned IP addresses across all jails
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Whitelisted IPs
                                        Count of IPs that will never be banned (add your own IP here!)
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Active Jails
                                        Number of fail2ban jails monitoring different threat types
                                    

                                    
                                
                            

                        

                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Security - Banned IPs
                        

                        
                        
View all currently banned IP addresses with the jail that banned them. Unban IPs manually if needed. Use Manual Ban to block specific IPs immediately.

                        
                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Security - Whitelisted IPs
                        

                        
                        
Whitelisted IPs are exempt from banning. IMPORTANT: Add your own IP address here to prevent accidental lockout during testing. Localhost (127.0.0.1) is whitelisted by default. Entries you add manually are exempt from EVERY protection (including dashboard login). Entries marked 'SIP only' were added automatically from a SIP trunk and are exempt only from the SIP jails (ports 5060/5061) and the repeat-offender (recidive) ban — they are still subject to dashboard login protection, so a trunk peer can never use its whitelist entry to bypass web security.

                        
                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Security - Protection Thresholds
                        

                        
                        
                        

                            

                                
                                    

                                        Field
                                        Description
                                    

                                
                                
                                    
                                    

                                        Auth Failures
                                        Ban after X failed login attempts (wrong password) within Y seconds. Default: 3 attempts in 5 min = 30 min ban.
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Invalid Email
                                        Ban after X attempts with non-existent email addresses. Default: 5 attempts in 5 min = 30 min ban.
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Scanner Detection
                                        Ban IPs probing for vulnerabilities (.env, .git, wp-admin, etc.). Default: 5 requests in 1 min = 24 hr ban.
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Rate Limiting
                                        Ban IPs making too many requests (DDoS protection). Default: 100 requests in 10 sec = 10 min ban.
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Recidive
                                        Extended ban for repeat offenders banned multiple times. Default: 3 bans in 24 hrs = 7 day ban.
                                    

                                    
                                
                            

                        

                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Security - Lockout Recovery
                        

                        
                        
If locked out: 1) SSH to server and run 'sudo fail2ban-client set livekit-auth unbanip YOUR_IP', or 2) Edit data/security_settings.json to add your IP to whitelist, or 3) Remove /etc/fail2ban/jail.d/livekit.conf and reload fail2ban.

                        
                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Dependencies Tab
                        

                        
                        
                        

                            

                                
                                    

                                        Field
                                        Description
                                    

                                
                                
                                    
                                    

                                        Required Dependencies
                                        Install packages for AI providers (Deepgram, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, etc.). Temporary installs lost on restart; Permanent adds to pyproject.toml.
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Available Updates
                                        Shows when package updates are available. Appears at top of tab with compatibility warning.
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Compatibility Warning
                                        Always check version compatibility before upgrading. Packages like boto3 and aiobotocore have strict version constraints.
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Installed Packages
                                        View all installed LiveKit and AI provider packages with current versions.
                                    

                                    
                                
                            

                        

                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             System Resources Tab
                        

                        
                        
Monitor running services (Agent Worker, Dashboard, Redis, LiveKit). View memory/CPU usage, restart services, or edit resource limits (memory cap, CPU quota).

                        
                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             System Resources - Agent Performance
                        

                        
                        
                        

                            

                                
                                    

                                        Field
                                        Description
                                    

                                
                                
                                    
                                    

                                        Keep Agent Worker Warm
                                        Number of agent worker processes kept pre-spawned (0–4). Each warm process holds the prewarmed voice-detection model, turn-detector, and Google OAuth token, costing about 400 MB of RAM. 0 = cold start on every call (saves RAM but adds 2-5 s startup delay every time); note the main worker + forkserver still run, so this trims the idle pool rather than freeing all agent memory. 1 = default, recommended for most installs; the first call of the day responds noticeably faster. 2 = use this if back-to-back inbound calls within ~1 second are common, so the second call doesn't wait for a process to spawn. 3 and 4 are for boxes whose agent memory limit has been raised — at ~400 MB each they need roughly 1.2–1.6 GB of headroom before the active call, so raise the agent memory cap FIRST or the worker will run out of memory and calls go silent. The editor shows the live memory math when you pick 3 or 4. Saving this setting restarts the agent service.
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Agent Development Mode
                                        When ON, the agent ignores the CPU load threshold and accepts every job (useful when testing on a small VM). Production servers should leave this OFF so the worker rejects jobs gracefully when overloaded.

Set per-provider rates for LLM, STT, TTS, and Realtime services, plus margin settings for sub-user pricing.

                                        Field
                                        Description
                                    

                                
                                
                                    
                                    

                                        LLM Pricing
                                        Set cost per 1M input/output tokens for each LLM provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.)
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        STT Pricing
                                        Set cost per minute of audio for each speech-to-text provider
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        TTS Pricing
                                        Set cost per 1M characters for each text-to-speech provider
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Realtime Pricing
                                        Set cost for audio-to-audio providers (Google Gemini Live, OpenAI Realtime, xAI Grok, AWS Nova Sonic). Supports token-based (per 1M tokens) or flat-rate (per minute) pricing.
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Default Rates
                                        Pre-filled with approximate public pricing. Adjust to match your negotiated rates.
                                    

                                    
                                
                            

                        

                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Analytics - Margin & Revenue
                        

                        
                        
                        

                            

                                
                                    

                                        Field
                                        Description
                                    

                                
                                
                                    
                                    

                                        Margin Percentage
                                        Markup percentage applied on top of provider costs. Sub-users see the adjusted price.
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Revenue Tracking
                                        The Price tab shows both raw cost and margin revenue based on configured markup.
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Per-User Margin
                                        Different margin rates can be set per sub-user for custom pricing tiers.
                                    

                                    
                                
                            

                        

                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Email Tab
                        

                        
                        
Configure email settings for dashboard notifications, password resets, and reports. This is separate from agent-triggered emails in the Communication tool.

                        
                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Email - Provider Configuration
                        

                        
                        
                        

                            

                                
                                    

                                        Field
                                        Description
                                    

                                
                                
                                    
                                    

                                        Provider
                                        Choose SMTP (traditional email server) or AWS SES (Amazon Simple Email Service)
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        SMTP Settings
                                        Host, port, username, password, and TLS option for standard mail servers
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        AWS SES Settings
                                        Region, access key, and secret key for Amazon SES. Sender email must be verified in AWS console.
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        From Email
                                        Required sender email address (must be verified for SES)
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        From Name
                                        Display name shown in email recipients' inbox
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Reply-To
                                        Optional reply-to address for responses
                                    

                                    
                                
                            

                        

                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Email - Testing & Logs
                        

                        
                        
                        

                            

                                
                                    

                                        Field
                                        Description
                                    

                                
                                
                                    
                                    

                                        Test Email
                                        Send a test email to verify your configuration is working correctly
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Email Log
                                        View recent sent emails with status (sent/failed), recipient, subject, and type. Limited to last 100 entries.
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Clear Logs
                                        Remove all email log entries
                                    

                                    
                                
                            

                        

                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Email - Templates
                        

                        
                        
Manage email templates used for system emails like password resets and test emails. Templates support variables using {{variable}} syntax.

                        
                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Email - Template Types
                        

                        
                        
                        

                            

                                
                                    

                                        Field
                                        Description
                                    

                                
                                
                                    
                                    

                                        System Templates
                                        Pre-configured templates for test emails and password resets. Can be edited but not deleted.
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Custom Templates
                                        User-created templates for custom notifications. Can be edited and deleted.
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Template Variables
                                        Use {{variable}} for dynamic content. Available variables are shown in the template list.
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Conditionals
                                        Use {{#var}}content{{/var}} to show content only when variable is set
                                    

                                    
                                
                            

                        

                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Email - Template Editor
                        

                        
                        
                        

                            

                                
                                    

                                        Field
                                        Description
                                    

                                
                                
                                    
                                    

                                        Template ID
                                        Unique identifier (lowercase, no spaces). Cannot be changed after creation.
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Name
                                        Display name shown in the template list
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Subject
                                        Email subject line (supports variables)
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        HTML Content
                                        Full HTML email body with styling and variables
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Preview
                                        View rendered template with sample data before saving
                                    

                                    
                                
                            

                        

                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Email - Template Variables
                        

                        
                        
Use {{variable}} syntax for dynamic content. Use {{#var}}content{{/var}} for conditional blocks that only appear when variable has a value.

                        
                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Email - Common Variables
                        

                        
                        
                        

                            

                                
                                    

                                        Field
                                        Description
                                    

                                
                                
                                    
                                    

                                        {{from_name}}
                                        Sender display name configured in Email Settings
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        {{from_email}}
                                        Sender email address configured in Email Settings
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        {{logo_url}}
                                        Full URL to custom logo (empty if no logo configured). Use with conditional: {{#logo_url}}<img src='{{logo_url}}'>{{/logo_url}}
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        {{timestamp}}
                                        Current date/time when the email is sent
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        {{provider}}
                                        Email provider name (SMTP or SES)
                                    

                                    
                                
                            

                        

                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Email - Password Reset Variables
                        

                        
                        
                        

                            

                                
                                    

                                        Field
                                        Description
                                    

                                
                                
                                    
                                    

                                        {{username}}
                                        User's name or email address
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        {{reset_link}}
                                        Password reset URL (valid for 1 hour, single use)
                                    

                                    
                                
                            

                        

                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Backup Tab
                        

                        
                        
Create and restore complete system backups including all Redis data and configuration files. Supports both manual downloads and automated cloud backups.

                        
                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Backup - What's Included
                        

                        
                        
                        

                            

                                
                                    

                                        Field
                                        Description
                                    

                                
                                
                                    
                                    

                                        Redis Data
                                        All agents, users, call history, transcriptions, tool configurations, settings (analytics, email, email templates, duration filters), audit logs, 2FA configurations, and agent tester preferences
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Config Files
                                        .env file with API keys, Google Cloud credentials files
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Custom Files
                                        Custom logo if configured
                                    

                                    
                                
                            

                        

                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Backup - Manual Operations
                        

                        
                        
                        

                            

                                
                                    

                                        Field
                                        Description
                                    

                                
                                
                                    
                                    

                                        Download Backup
                                        Creates a timestamped .zip file containing all data. Store securely - contains API keys and credentials.
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Restore from File
                                        Upload a backup .zip to restore. WARNING: Overwrites all existing data. Restart required after restore.
                                    

                                    
                                
                            

                        

                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Backup - Cloud Backup
                        

                        
                        
Requires AWS S3 or Google Cloud Storage configured in Integrations tab. When both are configured, you can choose which provider to use for automatic backups. Backups are stored in 'system_backups/' folder in your bucket.

                        
                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Backup - Automatic Schedule
                        

                        
                        
                        

                            

                                
                                    

                                        Field
                                        Description
                                    

                                
                                
                                    
                                    

                                        Off
                                        No automatic backups - manual only
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Daily
                                        Automatic backup every 24 hours
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Weekly
                                        Automatic backup every 7 days
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Provider Selection
                                        When both S3 and GCS are configured, choose which provider to use for scheduled backups
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Max Backups to Keep
                                        Limit the number of cloud backups retained. When exceeded, the oldest backups are automatically deleted after each new backup (scheduled or manual). Set to 0 for unlimited.
                                    

                                    
                                
                            

                        

                        
                    

                    
                    

                        

                             Backup - Cloud Operations
                        

                        
                        
                        

                            

                                
                                    

                                        Field
                                        Description
                                    

                                
                                
                                    
                                    

                                        Backup Now
                                        Immediately create and upload a backup to cloud storage
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Restore from Cloud
                                        Download and restore from a previous cloud backup
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        Delete
                                        Remove old backups from cloud storage to save space
